Her coming to our house was not the unbelievable part.
The state she was in—that was.

Wounds everywhere.
Terribly hurt.

Even on a battlefield, such a sight would be rare.

No. This was an insult to the very idea of a fight.
Many against one, tormenting someone at their mercy—without something like that, how could she have come to this?

en.html:
Whatever else, first catch her. I ran to her and held her as she staggered.
Her blurred gaze struck me, but it would not focus.

She was dying.
On the southern battlefields I had seen so many deaths. Now that experience supplied an answer nobody had asked it for. Too late.

A person with these eyes could not be saved.

...Why?
What had happened? How had it come to this!?

en.html:
In my life—especially those years of military service—I had seen people close to me die more than once.

One thing I had learned.
When someone died, the part of your heart entrusted to them died also.

A piece died. A hole remained.
Warmth gone, emptiness in its place.

...With Mizuhi's death, that emptiness was so large, so deep. Until it opened, I had not imagined it.

Such a short time.
That was all this person and I had shared.

And still.
So much of my heart had been left with her.

Lose her first, understand afterward.
Perhaps I had lost somebody I must not have lost.

Perhaps this person had been necessary to the person I was—

と。

　温かいものが無くなり、代わりに空虚なものが生ま
れる。

　こうなるまで、思いもしなかった程に――大きく、
深かった。

のだ。

知る。

　この人は、俺という人間に必要な存在だったのでは
ないかと――

I muttered the rebuke at myself.

—What was there to discover now? It was obvious.

Whatever else, I could not leave her like this. Even in death, she should be washed clean—◆no, there did not seem to be time for that. At least lay her on a futon.

Alone, it would take too long.

en.html:
Hikaru"Mother. Standing there, you are obstructing."
Subaru"...That sacred key. What are you doing with it?"
Hikaru"A question that does not require asking. This object has one use only."
Subaru"If it's for scratching your back, better equipment is available in the sitting room."
Hikaru"For your use, Mother."
Subaru"...How do you know all this? Where the key is kept, even how to use it?"
Hikaru"Hikaru was watching. What that one sees and hears reaches me also."
Subaru"...?"
Hikaru"Well? Repeated announcements are not my intention. You are in the way, Mother. Kindly move."
Subaru"What are you planning?"
Hikaru"To release my tsurugi. Apparently the situation is urgent, no?"
Subaru"Your tsurugi...?"
Hikaru"..."
Subaru"...And with this tsurugi? What will you do?"
Hikaru"Mother. Spare a thought for the person obliged to answer this procession of obvious questions."
Subaru"Achha, my apologies. Small pieces, please, for your slow mother. Practice for when I go completely senile."
Hikaru"Very well, since it cannot be helped. Massacre, simply. These people said to be coming to attack the town."
Subaru"..."
Hikaru"The word also needs explaining?"
Subaru"No, thank you. Hearing it is enough to turn my stomach."
Hikaru"Excellent."
Subaru"You are not passing."
Hikaru"..."
Subaru"...Kill them, and then what, Hikaru? Only hatred left behind."
Hikaru"Nothing left behind."
Subaru"...Why not?"
Hikaru"Every last one will be killed."
Subaru"..."
Subaru"Even those bandits have relatives. Somebody among them will want revenge."
Subaru"And those people will have at least one friend to grieve for them, na? The hatred remains. It always does."
Hikaru"Nothing remains."
Subaru"...Kyun nahin? Tell me why."

光「母上。 　そこに立たれては邪魔です」
統「……その御鑰かぎ、どうするつもりだ」
光「訊くまでもないことを。 　こんなもの、使い道は一つきりでしょう」
統「孫の手にするなら居間にもうちょっとマシ なやつがあるぞ」
光「それは母上がお使い下さい」
統「……なんでおまえが知ってるんだ。 　御鑰の場所と、使い方まで」
光「光が見ていましたから・・・・・・・・・・。 　あれが見聞きした事は光おれにも伝わります」
統「……？」
光「さて？　何度も申し上げるつもりはありま せんが。 　邪魔です、母上。おどき下さい」
統「何をする気だよ」
光「おれの・・・劒冑を解放するのです。 　どうやら、差し迫った事態のようではあり ませんか」
統「おまえの劒冑……？」
光「……」
統「……その劒冑で？ 　何をするって？」
光「母上。 　わかりきった問いにいちいち答えねばなら ないこちらの身にもなって頂けますか」
統「そりゃすまんこってした。 　ものわかりの悪い母に噛み砕いて説明して やってくれ、娘よ。母がボケてしまった時の 練習だと思って」
光「致し方ありません。 　ただ、鏖殺するだけです。町に攻めて来る 連中とやらを」
統「……」
光「単語の意味もご説明しましょうか」
統「結構です。 　聞くだに胸が悪くなりそうだ」
光「それは上々」
統「通さない」
光「……」
統「……殺してどうする？　光。 　後には恨みが残るだけだよ」
光「残りませぬ」
統「……なんでだ」
光「一人残らず殺しますゆえ」
統「……」
統「あの山賊どもにだって親類縁者くらいいる だろうさ。 　その中には復讐心に駆られる奴もいるだろ」
統「そいつら自身にだって、死ねば悲しむ仲間 の一人くらいいるだろ。 　恨みは必ず残る」
光「残りませぬ」
統「……なんでだよ」

en.html:
Hikaru"Every last one will be killed. Everyone weaker than Hikaru."
Subaru"............"
Subaru"That... is not the martial way, Hikaru."
Hikaru"It is precisely the martial way."
Subaru"What are you..."
Hikaru"Then enlighten me. What does Mother intend to do?"
Subaru"Go and talk sense into them."
Hikaru"And if circumstances do not permit this conversation?"
Subaru"...Stop them. Without killing."
Hikaru"Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha...!"
Subaru"..."
Hikaru"You think this arrangement is possible?"
Subaru"Haan, possible. Kageaki will help."
Hikaru"..."
Subaru"He has done it once already. Again also, he can do it."
Hikaru"...Understood. That woman just now... Mother has already made Kageaki do such a thing once."
Subaru"Yes."
Hikaru"Therefore, repeat the performance."
Subaru"Yes..."
Hikaru"Absolute fool."
Subaru"...What did you say?"
Hikaru"That this worthless performance of yours brought about today's situation—has the possibility occurred to you?"
Subaru"...Meaning?"
Hikaru"These bandits underestimated martial power. It is nothing but the art of killing. They misunderstood that."
Hikaru"Because you displayed a counterfeit, Mother. Fight, lose, and still avoid being killed—you made them believe it."
Subaru"............"
Hikaru"They took martial power lightly. Something to be underestimated."
Hikaru"So now, full of themselves, they come to attack. Understanding has still not arrived, Mother?"
Subaru"...Even if that is so. We keep stopping them until they have no wish to fight."
Subaru"That is the martial way."
Hikaru"No. Martial power is not this long-winded chutiyapa."
Hikaru"The strong destroy the weak. That is martial power."
Subaru"I taught you, Hikaru! The character is 'stop' and 'spear'! STOP THE SPEAR!"
Hikaru"Wrong! STOP BY THE SPEAR! Those same parts—stop a life with it!"
Subaru"...!!"
Hikaru"A blade puts an end to life! No other work!"
Subaru"And killing achieves what!? Nobody gains anything!"
Subaru"What use is a martial way like that...?"
Hikaru"Really? Your martial teaching was not worth cow dung, Mother. Muramasa's has brought Hikaru out into the world. Here I stand, no?"
Subaru"...!? Muramasa... taught you?"
Hikaru"Therefore... Hikaru standing here is the proof. My martial way is the true one!"
Subaru"You..."
Hikaru"Raasta chhodiye, Mother. Move aside. This is the final request."
Subaru"............ Who are you?"
Hikaru"...Khu."
Hikaru"Your own daughter's face, forgotten already? Mother?"
Subaru"Hard to say. The child I carried and gave birth to, yes, personality defects were in generous supply. Whether she qualified as a human being, frankly, I had questions."
Subaru"But a face as monstrous as yours? That I don't remember."
Hikaru"Huh-huh...!"
Subaru"..."
Hikaru"Very good eyes, Mother!"
Subaru"Don't come closer. Back away. Out!"
Hikaru"And if I decline— WHAT WILL YOU DO, SUBARU MINATO!?"
Subaru"—!!"

光「一人残らず殺しますゆえ。 　この光より弱き者はすべて・・・」
統「…………」
統「それは…… 　武の道じゃないぞ。光」
光「武の道にございます」
統「何を……」
光「ではお聞かせ下さい。 　母上はどうなさりたいのです？」
統「説得してくるよ」
光「そんな状況ではなかったら？」
統「……止めるさ。 　けど、殺しはしない」
光「はははははは……！」
統「……」
光「そのような事ができるとお思いか？」
統「できるさ。 　景明も手伝ってくれる」
光「……」
統「あの子は一度それをやってみせた。 　もう一度だって、きっとできる」
光「……成程。それで、さっきの女……。 　母上は一度、やらせたのですね。景明に、 そんなこと・・・・・を」
統「ああ」
光「だからもう一度やると」
統「ああ……」
光「戯け」
統「……何ぃ……」
光「あなたのその下らぬ所業が―― 　今日の事態を招いたとは思いませぬのか」
統「……どういう意味だよ」
光「山賊どもとやらは、武を侮った。 　真相は殺法・・に過ぎぬ武を、見誤った」
光「あなたが偽りの武を見せたからだ、母上。 　戦って負けても殺されずに済む・・・・・・・などと彼ら に信じさせた」
統「…………」
光「彼らは武を軽んじた。 　甘く見た」
光「だから嵩に懸かって攻め寄せて来る。 　おわかりになりませぬか、母上」
統「……そうだとしても。 　連中が戦う気を無くすまで、防ぎ続ければ いいこった」
統「そいつが武の道だよ」
光「違います。 　武はそんなまだるっこしい・・・・・・・ものではない」
光「強きをもって弱きを滅ぼす。 　それが、武にござります」
統「教えたはずだぞ光！ 　戈を止めると書いて武の一文字！」
光「否！ 　戈にて止とどむと書いて武の一文字！」
統「……!!」
光「刃は生命に止めを呉れるもの！ 　他に用途は何も無し！」
統「だからって、殺してどうなるよ！ 　誰も得しねえだろ！」
統「そんな武道、何の意味があるってんだ……」
光「そうでしょうか？ 　母上の教えてくださった武道こそ、糞の役 にも立ちませなんだが……村正が示した武は こうして光を世に送り出してくれましたぞ？」
統「……!? 　村正が……示した？」
光「つまりは…… 　こうしてここに光の在ることが、我が武の 真実たる証明あかし！」
統「おまえ……」
光「おどきあれ、母上。 　これで最後とさせて頂く」
統「…………。 　おまえ、誰だ？」
光「……くふっ」
光「娘の顔を見忘れたか。 　母上」
統「どうだったかな。 　わたしがお腹なか痛めて産んだ子は、そりゃー 性格面でアレなとこが多過ぎたし正直人間と してこいつどうなのよって感じだったけど」
統「おまえほど、化物じみた面つらはしてなかった と思うんだが」
光「ふっふ……！」
統「……」
光「良い眼をしているではないか、母上！」
統「来るな。 　そのまま下がって、外へ出ろ！」
光「嫌と申さば、 　――――如何する!?　湊斗統!!」
統「ッ!!」

en.text:
—She could stop her.
Of that, Subaru was certain.

Her daughter's ability she knew. Talent bordering on the inhuman, if one was being honest.

A year ago, just before the illness, Hikaru's technique had been nearly complete.
Nearly. Openings remained. Subaru could still enter them.

Since then, a year with no progress. By common sense, some decline should have occurred. Common sense, however, did not seem worth depending on here.

Look at that fluid stance. 'Just out of the sickbed' sounded like somebody's very poor joke.
Still, Subaru judged she could restrain her.

The variety, sharpness, strength visible in that stance—all within what she could handle. Barely. But a paper's thickness was enough to win by.

Subaru Minato had some pride in her own art. Six more months of training for Hikaru—no, even three—and matters might be different. At this stage, she still had the advantage. So she judged.

—From the reverse of Karan, mate in eight moves.

She laid out the path to victory in her mind. Examined it again. ...Nothing to upset the calculation.

Then carry it out. She tilted her weight forward and waited for the moment to begin.◆

The calculation collapsed there itself.

ja.text:
――止められる筈だ、と……
　統には、確信があった。

　娘の力量は知っている。
　有体ありていに言って、妖怪じみた天才だ。

　一年前、病に倒れる直前、その技術はもう完成まで
間近だった。
　が……まだ、付け入る隙は残していた。

　あれから一年。光の技は停滞している。
　いや、後退しているはずだ――常識的に考えれば。
それについてはどうもあまり期待しない方が良さそう
だったが。

　光の流麗な立ち姿は、これで病み上がりなどと言わ
れてもつまらぬ諧謔ギャグにしか思えない。
　しかし――まだ、抑え切れる。統はそう踏んだ。

　構かまえから窺える技の多様さ、鋭さ、強靭さは統の許容
量に収まる。
　危うい線ではあっても、紙一枚の差で勝てる。

　湊斗統にも己の術技に自負するところがあった。
　あと半年――いや三ヶ月も光が修練を重ねていたら
わからなかったろうが、現段階ではまだ優ると見た。

　――花乱カランの裏から、八手で詰み。

　脳裏に勝利への図式を思い描く。
　推敲。……この計算を崩す要素は無い。

　ならば図式を実行する。
　統は重心を前へ傾け、仕掛ける気を窺った。◆
　
　そこで、計算は崩壊した。
